verses.text_uthmani: يسٓ

trs.20: Yā, Seen.<sup foot_note=197154>1</sup>
trs.85: Ya Sin
trs.22: Ya Sin.
trs.203: Yâ-Sîn.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ

trs.20: By the wise<sup foot_note=197155>1</sup> Qur’ān,
trs.85: By the wise Quran,
trs.22: By the Qur'an, full of Wisdom,-
trs.203: By the Qur’ân, full of wisdom (i.e. full of laws, evidence, and proofs),

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

trs.20: Indeed you, [O Muḥammad], are from among the messengers,
trs.85: you [Muhammad] are truly one of the mes-sengers sent
trs.22: Thou art indeed one of the messengers,
trs.203: Truly, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are one of the Messengers,

verses.text_uthmani: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ

trs.20: On a straight path.
trs.85: on a straight path,
trs.22: On a Straight Way.
trs.203: On the Straight Path (i.e. on Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism).

verses.text_uthmani: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ

trs.20: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
trs.85: with a revelation from the Almighty, the Lord of Mercy,
trs.22: It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
trs.203: (This is a Revelation) sent down by the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

verses.text_uthmani: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ

trs.20: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
trs.85: to warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so they are unaware.
trs.22: In order that thou mayest admonish a people, whose fathers had received no admonition, and who therefore remain heedless (of the Signs of Allah).
trs.203: In order that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are heedless.

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Already the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
trs.85: The verdict has been passed against most of them, for they refuse to believe.
trs.22: The Word is proved true against the greater part of them: for they do not believe.
trs.203: Indeed the Word (of punishment) has proved true against most of them, so they will not believe.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَـٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَـٰلًا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
trs.85: [It is as if] We had placed [iron] collars around their necks, right up to their chins so that their heads are forced up
trs.22: We have put yokes round their necks right up to their chins, so that their heads are forced up (and they cannot see).
trs.203: Verily We have put on their necks iron collars reaching to the chins, so that their heads are raised up.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّا فَأَغْشَيْنَـٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
trs.85: and set barriers before and behind them, blocking their vision: they cannot see.
trs.22: And We have put a bar in front of them and a bar behind them, and further, We have covered them up; so that they cannot see.
trs.203: And We have put a barrier before them, and a barrier behind them, and We have covered them up, so that they cannot see.

verses.text_uthmani: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
trs.85: It is all the same to them whether you warn them or not: they will not believe.
trs.22: The same is it to them whether thou admonish them or thou do not admonish them: they will not believe.
trs.203: It is the same to them whether you warn them or you warn them not, they will not believe.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَأَجْرٍ كَرِيمٍ

trs.20: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
trs.85: You can warn only those who will follow the Quran and hold the Merciful One in awe, though they cannot see Him: give such people the glad news of forgiveness and a noble reward.
trs.22: Thou canst but admonish such a one as follows the Message and fears the (Lord) Most Gracious, unseen: give such a one, therefore, good tidings, of Forgiveness and a Reward most generous.
trs.203: You can only warn him who follows the Reminder (the Qur’ân), and fears the Most Gracious (Allâh) unseen. Bear you to such one the glad tidings of forgiveness, and a generous reward (i.e. Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَـٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
trs.85: We shall certainly bring the dead back to life, and We record what they send ahead of them as well as what they leave behind: We keep an account of everything in a clear Record.
trs.22: Verily We shall give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before and that which they leave behind, and of all things have We taken account in a clear Book (of evidence).
trs.203: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces<sup foot_note=154829>1</sup> and all things We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
trs.85: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
trs.22: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it.
trs.203: And put forward to them a similitude: the (story of the) dwellers of the town, [it is said that the town was Antioch (Antâkiya)], when there came Messengers to them.

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
trs.85: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
trs.22: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
trs.203: When We sent to them two Messengers, they belied them both; so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: "Verily we have been sent to you as Messengers."

translation.text: but they denied both of them

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ

trs.20: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
trs.85: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
trs.22: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
trs.203: They (people of the town) said: "You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Most Gracious (Allâh) has revealed nothing. You are only telling lies."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
trs.85: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
trs.22: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
trs.203: The Messengers said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent as Messengers to you,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

trs.20: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
trs.85: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
trs.22: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
trs.203: "And our duty is only to convey plainly (the Message)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

trs.20: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
trs.85: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
trs.22: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
trs.203: They (people) said: "For us, we see an evil omen from you: if you cease not, we will surely stone you, and a painful torment will touch you from us."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ

trs.20: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it<sup foot_note=197156>1</sup> because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
trs.85: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
trs.22: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
trs.203: They (Messengers) said: "Your evil omens be with you! (Do you call it "evil omen") because you are admonished? Nay, but you are a people Musrifûn (transgressing all bounds by committing all kinds of great sins, and by disobeying Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

trs.20: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
trs.85: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
trs.22: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers:
trs.203: And there came a man running from the farthest part of the town. He said: "O my people! Obey the Messengers.

verses.text_uthmani: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
trs.85: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
trs.22: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
trs.203: "Obey those who ask no wages of you (for themselves), and who are rightly guided.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
trs.85: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
trs.22: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
trs.203: "And why should I not worship Him (Allâh Alone) Who has created me and to Whom you shall be returned.

verses.text_uthmani: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ

trs.20: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
trs.85: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
trs.22: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
trs.203: "Shall I take besides Him âlihah (gods)? If the Most Gracious (Allâh) intends me any harm, their intercession will be of no use for me whatsoever, nor can they save me?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
trs.85: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
trs.22: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
trs.203: "Then verily, I should be in plain error.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ

trs.20: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
trs.85: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
trs.22: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
trs.203: "Verily! I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me!"

verses.text_uthmani: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: It was said, "Enter Paradise."<sup foot_note=197157>1</sup> He said, "I wish my people could know
trs.85: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
trs.22: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
trs.203: It was said (to him when the disbelievers killed him): "Enter Paradise." He said: "Would that my people knew<sup foot_note=154830>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

trs.20: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
trs.85: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
trs.22: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
trs.203: "That my Lord (Allâh) has forgiven me, and made me of the honoured ones!"

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ

trs.20: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
trs.85: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
trs.22: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
trs.203: And We sent not against his people after him a host from the heaven, nor was it needful for Us to send (such a thing).

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ

trs.20: It was not but one shout,<sup foot_note=197158>1</sup> and immediately they were extinguished.
trs.85: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
trs.22: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
trs.203: It was but one Saihah (shout) and lo! they (all) were still (silent,dead,destroyed).

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

trs.20: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
trs.85: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
trs.22: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him!
trs.203: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.

verses.text_uthmani: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them<sup foot_note=197159>1</sup> will not return?
trs.85: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
trs.22: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
trs.203: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

trs.20: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
trs.85: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
trs.22: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
trs.203: And surely, all - everyone of them will be brought before Us.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
trs.85: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
trs.22: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
trs.203: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ

trs.20: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
trs.85: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
trs.22: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
trs.203: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.

translation.text: and We caused to gush forth

verses.text_uthmani: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

trs.20: That they may eat of His fruit.<sup foot_note=197161>1</sup> And their hands have not produced it,<sup foot_note=197160>2</sup> so will they not be grateful?
trs.85: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
trs.22: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
trs.203: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof - and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?

verses.text_uthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: Exalted is He who created all pairs<sup foot_note=197162>1</sup> - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
trs.85: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
trs.22: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
trs.203: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own (human) kind (male and female), and of that which they know not.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ

trs.20: And a sign for them is the night. We remove<sup foot_note=197163>1</sup> from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
trs.85: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
trs.22: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
trs.203: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ

trs.20: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
trs.85: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
trs.22: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
trs.203: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ

trs.20: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
trs.85: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
trs.22: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
trs.203: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

trs.20: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
trs.85: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
trs.22: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
trs.203: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

trs.20: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers<sup foot_note=197164>1</sup> in a laden ship.
trs.85: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
trs.22: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
trs.203: And an Ayâh (sign) for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship [of Nûh (Noah)].

verses.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ

trs.20: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
trs.85: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
trs.22: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
trs.203: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ

trs.20: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
trs.85: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
trs.22: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
trs.203: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout (or helper) for them (to hear their cry for help), nor will they be saved.

translation.text: (would be) a responder to a cry

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

trs.20: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
trs.85: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
trs.22: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
trs.203: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ

trs.20: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you;<sup foot_note=197166>1</sup> perhaps you will receive mercy..."<sup foot_note=197165>2</sup>
trs.85: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
trs.22: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
trs.203: And when it is said to them: "Fear of that which is before you (worldly torments), and that which is behind you (torments in the Hereafter), in order that you may receive Mercy (i.e. if you believe in Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allâh with righteous deeds)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

trs.20: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
trs.85: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
trs.22: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
trs.203: And never came an Ayâh from among the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
trs.85: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
trs.22: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
trs.203: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allâh has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allâh willed, He (Himself) would have fed? You are only in a plain error."

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
trs.85: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
trs.22: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
trs.203: And they say: "When will this promise (i.e. Resurrection) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ

trs.20: They do not await except one blast<sup foot_note=197167>1</sup> which will seize them while they are disputing.
trs.85: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
trs.22: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
trs.203: They await only but a single Saihah (shout), which will seize them while they are disputing!

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
trs.85: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
trs.22: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
trs.203: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ

trs.20: And the Horn will be blown;<sup foot_note=197168>1</sup> and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
trs.85: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
trs.22: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
trs.203: And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

trs.20: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
trs.85: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
trs.22: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
trs.203: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious (Allâh) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ

trs.20: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
trs.85: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
trs.22: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
trs.203: It will be but a single Saihah (shout), so behold they will all be brought up before Us!

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
trs.85: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
trs.22: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
trs.203: This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ

trs.20: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
trs.85: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
trs.22: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
trs.203: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.

verses.text_uthmani: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ

trs.20: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
trs.85: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
trs.22: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
trs.203: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.

verses.text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ

trs.20: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
trs.85: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
trs.22: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
trs.203: They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.

verses.text_uthmani: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ

trs.20: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
trs.85: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
trs.22: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
trs.203: (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

trs.20: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.<sup foot_note=197169>1</sup>
trs.85: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
trs.22: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
trs.203: (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
trs.85: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
trs.22: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
trs.203: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ

trs.20: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
trs.85: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
trs.22: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
trs.203: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.<sup foot_note=154831>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
trs.85: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
trs.22: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
trs.203: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
trs.85: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
trs.22: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
trs.203: This is Hell which you were promised!

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ

trs.20: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."<sup foot_note=197170>1</sup>
trs.85: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
trs.22: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
trs.203: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.<sup foot_note=154832>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

trs.20: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
trs.85: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
trs.22: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
trs.203: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?<sup foot_note=197171>1</sup>
trs.85: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
trs.22: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
trs.203: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.<sup foot_note=197172>1</sup>
trs.85: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
trs.22: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
trs.203: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.<sup foot_note=154833>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation;<sup foot_note=197173>1</sup> so will they not understand?
trs.85: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
trs.22: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
trs.203: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
trs.85: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
trs.22: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
trs.203: And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.

verses.text_uthmani: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

trs.20: To warn whoever is alive<sup foot_note=197174>1</sup> and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
trs.85: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
trs.22: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
trs.203: That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ

trs.20: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands<sup foot_note=197175>1</sup> have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
trs.85: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
trs.22: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
trs.203: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ

trs.20: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
trs.85: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
trs.22: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
trs.203: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ

trs.20: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
trs.85: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
trs.22: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
trs.203: And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

trs.20: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
trs.85: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
trs.22: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
trs.203: And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ

trs.20: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.<sup foot_note=197176>1</sup>
trs.85: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
trs.22: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
trs.203: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ

trs.20: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
trs.85: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
trs.22: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
trs.203: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once<sup foot_note=197177>1</sup> he is a clear adversary?
trs.85: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
trs.22: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
trs.203: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.

verses.text_uthmani: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ

trs.20: And he presents for Us an example<sup foot_note=197178>1</sup> and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
trs.85: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
trs.22: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
trs.203: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ

trs.20: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
trs.85: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
trs.22: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
trs.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ

trs.20: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
trs.85: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
trs.22: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
trs.203: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
trs.85: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
trs.22: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
trs.203: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ

trs.20: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
trs.85: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
trs.22: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
trs.203: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!

verses.text_uthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
trs.85: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
trs.22: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
trs.203: So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.
